blocks.x: MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

The workflows we industrialize here: Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting, Clinical evidence assembly, UDI/traceability. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.
MDR vigilance and performance data assembled manually; signal detection late.
EU CRA/MDR cybersecurity duties land on fleets with legacy firmware; SBOMs unknown.
Real-world device performance data underused for evidence packs.
Service cost per device unknown; contracts priced on tradition.
Device UDI/provenance evidence manual across the chain.
